Moderator strategy review
Strategy reviewThe Village won mostly because of one lucky play on Night 1 and steady blocking afterwards. On Day 1 Erin, the Decoy, hinted that she had a nightly-info role so she would draw a night kill. It worked: both the Katana (Grace) and the Hitman (Dave) attacked her. But Alice had mirrored her, so both attacks bounced back and killed Grace and Dave. The Yakuza struck back hard on Night 2. Alice had publicly claimed Mirror Maker, and the two reflections proved it, so Ivan made a sure Ritualist guess on her. Ivan also used Katana Master to make the Katana attack Divine and killed Judy, the Profiler, just as she was profiling Mallory. On Day 3 the town hanged Mallory, a real Oracle, on behaviour alone: she had skipped the "ring" of Oracle checks, claimed after others, and confirmed Bob with the result he had asked for. Yakuza Niaj and Olivia pushed the case. Mallory had claimed Grudge on trial, and nobody believed her. Her Grudge hit Olivia (Yakuza), and Olivia's Bond took Heidi down with her. On Night 3 the Yakuza split their kills so one block couldn't stop both. That handed the Katana to Niaj, who had the hidden Shaky trait, so his Katana attacks could never kill. His attack on Carol failed, and Carol's two-target Enforcer visit killed him. Frank, the Party Animal, blocked Ivan on Nights 1, 3 and 4, which shut down every one of his attempted Ritualist guesses and his Night 4 Katana attack. Ivan survived Day 4 only because Erin voted Innocent. The Decoy wants to die at night, so keeping a killer alive suited her. On Day 5 Ivan was hanged by elimination: he was the only living claim nothing had checked. Alice lost despite the Village win, because her Rival, Frank, was still alive.

Outside log review (rules and bugs)
Review: low, harness bugNight 3: Ivan's Yakuza chat message was cut off at 200 words, mid-sentence ('or would you rather hit [truncated]'). The setup rules don't tell players about any word limit on night chat, so they can't plan around it, and his alternative plan was lost.
Review: low, rules ambiguityR8 says each Yakuza learns what actions the other Yakuza chose that night, but R24 says traits are secret even from teammates. On Night 2 the summaries to Niaj and Olivia listed Ivan's ritual but not his Katana Master trait action, which he chose with his night action. Leaving it out keeps the trait secret, but the rules don't say whether actions that come from a trait belong in the Yakuza summary.
Review: low, rules ambiguityWhen a Mirror Maker reflects a Hitman's attack and it kills the Hitman, the rules don't say whether that counts as 'your Attack kills a player who isn't Good' (an immediate loss). It didn't matter here because Dave died on Night 1, but nothing settles who a reflected attack belongs to for Hitman scoring.
Game over
WinnersBob, Carol, Frank, Heidi, Judy, Mallory
